units.source_text: 惟对命限今日之语，略有所理解耳。”

en.t: Only the words about his life being limited to today did she understand a little.

units.source_text: 对中将说：“你如此答复可也。”

en.t: She said to the lieutenant, You may answer him in this way.
But the lieutenant sent the original letter instead.

units.source_text: 藏人少将看到大女公子手笔，如获至宝，欢喜无限。

en.t: When the Kurando no Shosho saw the elder lady's handwriting, he treasured it as if he had gained a priceless jewel and was boundlessly delighted.

units.source_text: 又念她已相信他命限今日，更加感慨，眼泪流个不止。

en.t: Thinking also that she had believed his life would end that very day, he was even more deeply moved, and his tears would not stop.

units.source_text: 但他立刻模仿古歌“谁人丧名节”的语调，又寄诗诉怨：

en.t: Yet he immediately echoed the tone of the old poem about who had lost honor and fidelity, and sent another poem to voice his grievance.
